$schema.description: Schema URL used by JSON-aware editors for validation and completion.

schemaVersion.description: Settings format version. Absent means format 1. ctrlyoke stamps this field when it writes settings; an older host reads newer settings best-effort but refuses to write them.

general.description: General format, template, and behavior settings.

defaultFormat.description: Default file format for new workflows.

defaultTemplate.description: Default template to use for new workflows.

autoLoadRecentSession.description: Automatically load the most recent session on startup.

omitPreviouslyAttachedAgentsSkillsOnResu.description: When resuming an existing session, omit only agent/skill declarations that were already attached earlier in that same session.

includeFullDiffsInPriorContext.description: Include full file diffs in captured AI responses so later prior-context attachments contain the actual changes instead of edit summaries.

defaults.description: Default execution properties applied to all new workflows (mirrors ExecutionProperties).

harness.description: The default harness for workflows and steps that do not name one. Empty = auto-detect: the first installed harness in alphabetical order (antigravity-cli, claude-cli, codex-cli, copilot-cli, opencode-cli, qwen-cli).

models.description: The default model to use for each harness for new workflows.

additionalArgs.description: The default additional CLI arguments for each harness for new workflows. A workspace-scope value takes effect only after you approve that exact value on this machine, through the VS Code prompt or `ctrlyoke trust-workspace-settings`; until then the user value applies.

agent.description: Default portable ctrlyoke workflow agent attachment for new workflows. Native harness agent discovery is managed separately by the Agents & Skills settings page.

skills.description: Default portable ctrlyoke workflow skill attachments for new workflows. Native harness skill discovery is managed separately by the Agents & Skills settings page and does not determine workflow skill support.

secrets.description: Default secret environment-variable names granted to new workflows. Values are resolved by the execution host and never stored in workflow definitions.

executionMode.description: Default execution mode for new workflows. 'interactive' spawns a live terminal (TUI) the user can steer; 'headless' runs in the background with output in the Output panel. Workflows and individual steps can override this.

resumeSession.description: Resume an existing session when running a workflow.

priorContext.description: Default priorContext for every step that doesn't set its own.

mcpServers.description: Default MCP servers to attach to each prompt execution. A workspace-scope entry that launches a command takes effect only after you approve that exact entry on this machine, through the VS Code prompt or `ctrlyoke trust-workspace-settings`; until then the user value applies.

hooks.description: User-defined hooks to run at various execution lifecycle points. A workspace-scope hook takes effect only after you approve that exact hook on this machine, through the VS Code prompt or `ctrlyoke trust-workspace-settings`; until then the user value applies.

errorBehavior.description: Default policy for internal errors in any step phase. `null` (the default) stops the workflow unless the workflow or step sets its own policy.

toolPermissions.description: Default tool permission settings for prompt execution. Allowed Tools and Denied Tools are currently supported by Copilot CLI, Claude CLI, Qwen Code, and OpenCode; Qwen is inline granular support and OpenCode uses OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT without writing a workspace opencode.json. Codex and Antigravity only support an overall permission mode, not individual tool patterns, and do NOT ENFORCE these lists.

endCondition.description: Default end condition for new workflows. `null` (the default) means new workflows have no end condition. A workspace-scope value takes effect only after you approve that exact value on this machine, through the VS Code prompt or `ctrlyoke trust-workspace-settings`; until then the user value applies.

preCondition.description: Default pre-condition for new workflows. `null` (the default) means new workflows have no pre-condition. A workspace-scope value takes effect only after you approve that exact value on this machine, through the VS Code prompt or `ctrlyoke trust-workspace-settings`; until then the user value applies.

worktree.description: Default worktree behavior for workflows that omit a root worktree value. Uses the same false, shorthand, and object forms as workflow worktree; an inherited value degrades to ordinary execution when the workspace is not eligible.

root.description: Absolute or ~-prefixed directory where ctrlyoke creates worktrees.

coordination.description: Retention and participant settings for the execution-root coordination board.

readNotesPageSize.description: Maximum number of coordination entries returned by one read_notes page. Reads are always paged.

maxNoteLength.description: Maximum number of characters in a coordination note.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of coordination entries retained after compaction.

maxBoardBytes.description: Hard maximum size of the coordination board in bytes.

maxEntryAgeDays.description: Remove coordination notes older than this many days during compaction.

cliParticipantTtlMinutes.description: Lease lifetime for participants delivered through the CLI or built-in skill.

allowExternalParticipants.description: Allow participants not launched by ctrlyoke to join the coordination board.

languageServers.description: Managed language server definitions and language selections for the workspace editor.

definitions.description: Server id to command definition. Workspace definitions remain pending until the user approves them.

use.description: Language id to selected server id, or false to disable language intelligence. Workspace scope may select available servers.

settings.description: Server id to LSP initialization and workspace/configuration settings.

idleShutdownMinutes.description: User-only idle timeout in minutes before a server without open documents is stopped. 0 disables idle shutdown.

maxRunning.description: User-only maximum number of concurrently running language servers.

startOnLaunch.description: User-only opt-in to start selected language servers when the hosted server launches. Defaults to lazy startup.

runHistoryLocation.description: Store run history under the user state home or beside the workspace.

trashRetentionDays.description: Days a deleted run or workflow stays in Recently deleted before it is permanently removed. Every history delete, including Clear all history, moves runs to Recently deleted, where they can be restored until then.

permissions.description: Harness-specific path and sandbox permission settings.

codexApprovalPolicy.description: Approval policy for Codex CLI tool calls.

trustedExternalRoots.description: Absolute directory paths outside the workspace that ctrlyoke may read for prompt attachments and open from file links. Workspace files are always allowed. User-scope entries are trusted immediately; workspace-scope entries require a one-time batch approval before they take effect.

heuristicSecretRedactionEnabled.description: Apply pattern-based heuristics (e.g. 'token=...', 'Bearer ...', private-key blocks) when redacting logs, transports, exports, and history, in addition to exact matches of resolved managed/env secret values. Exact-value redaction of secrets ctrlyoke actually resolved always stays on regardless of this setting. Disable this if the heuristics are over-matching and corrupting legitimate output, such as code samples or public identifiers that merely look like credentials.

usageTracking.description: Controls workspace-local provider quota and observed-usage collection.

enabled.description: Enable usage collection for ctrlyoke-started harness sessions.

providerRefreshEnabled.description: Allow provider quota refreshes from configured collectors.

persistObservedUsage.description: Persist normalized observed usage in the workspace.

warningPercentUsed.description: Quota usage percentage at which ctrlyoke starts warning that a provider limit is close.

percentDirection.description: Whether quota percentages are displayed as used or remaining.

modelPricing.description: Optional per-harness/per-model USD pricing overrides. Rates are USD per one million tokens.

injectMode.description: When true, keeps the TUI alive between prompts and writes follow-up prompts directly into the PTY. Faster than restarting and avoids the Claude Code resume cache bug.

closeTerminalOnComplete.description: Automatically close the terminal when execution completes.

autoDeleteTempFiles.description: Automatically delete categorized prompt temp files after execution. Set to false to retain files in .ctrlyoke/temp/ for debugging.

contextResolutionFailure.description: How to handle a declared reference that fails to resolve: a missing/invalid secret (!NAME), an unknown skill (/skill:) or MCP server (/mcp:), an unresolved @file/#selection/#sym reference, or an unresolved ~diff/~staged/~stash/~<hash> git reference. 'warn' (default) reports a diagnostic and lets the step run anyway. 'fail' stops the step before the harness spawns, naming the unresolved reference.

maxPromptTimeoutSec.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a prompt to complete. `-1` means unlimited.

scriptTimeoutSec.description: Maximum time in seconds for pre-condition, end-condition, and script-step scripts to run. This setting must be greater than zero and has no unlimited value. A script's own `timeoutSec` (in seconds) overrides it.

ctrlyokeMcpMode.description: Whether ctrlyoke's own MCP server is attached natively or replaced with the built-in MCP tools skill. Only affects ctrlyoke's server, not other MCP servers configured in a workflow.

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of entries allowed in the run's steps array. `-1` means unlimited.

maxParallelSteps.description: Maximum number of active members in a parallel step group.

notifyOnExtension.description: Currently has no effect; queue extension notifications are not implemented.

maxWorkflowExecutionTimeSec.description: Maximum total execution time in seconds for a workflow. `-1` means unlimited.

runs.description: Execution run retention settings. History is always on.

maxRuns.description: Deletes entire runs—definition and output—oldest first. `-1` means unlimited.

historySearchCacheMb.description: Approximate working-set budget in MB for caching parsed history-search documents from the most recent runs, evicted oldest-first when exceeded. Bounds real extension-host process memory (RSS), not a literal byte count — actual RSS runs above this number due to V8 overhead the estimate can't see, so the default is calibrated from measured RSS on a real index rather than the byte math alone. 0 disables the cache.

scrollback.description: Maximum scrollback lines retained in memory.

macOptionIsMeta.description: Treat the macOS Option key as Meta.

wordSeparators.description: Characters treated as word boundaries on double-click selection.

replayBufferKb.description: Output replayed on webview reconnect, in KB.

shellExecutable.description: Override the shell spawned for user terminal sessions and for inline script text. Empty means auto-detect. A workspace-scope value takes effect only after you approve that exact value on this machine, through the VS Code prompt or `ctrlyoke trust-workspace-settings`; until then the user value applies.

mobileControlBar.description: When to show the mobile terminal control bar.

mobileBarLayout.description: Which keys the mobile terminal control bar shows: 'bar' keys are always visible, 'popup' keys sit behind the More menu, and 'hidden' keys are not shown.

mobileCustomShortcuts.description: Custom shortcuts in the mobile terminal control bar More menu.

showCliCommand.description: Show the CLI command being executed.

showHeadlessPermissionWarning.description: Show a warning when headless execution uses limited tool permissions.

autoFocusOutputOnExecution.description: Automatically expand the output section and switch to the relevant output view when a prompt starts. Headless runs show Output; interactive and inject-mode runs show Terminal.

openPromptsInSecondGroup.description: Open prompt files in a second editor group.

autoExpandEditorWhenTyping.description: Automatically grow the editor panel as you type past its current height, up to 60% of the available area. Shrinks back when text is deleted or the prompt is submitted.

useAbsolutePathReferences.description: Send absolute file paths to the harness/model instead of relative paths. Stored workflow text stays relative regardless of this setting. Forced on in multi-root workspaces and by harnesses that require it (e.g. Antigravity).

outputVirtualizationRowThreshold.description: Minimum projected output row count before the Output panel uses virtualization. 0 means always virtualize. `-1` means never.

collapsedToolOutputLineCount.description: Approximate number of wrapped lines shown for Bash and generic tool results before they collapse.

confirmDeleteOperations.description: Show a confirmation dialog before delete operations like removing prompts, deleting workflow history, or discarding untracked files.

confirmResetOperations.description: Show a confirmation dialog before resetting workflow start position.

confirmContinuationDiscardOperations.description: Show a confirmation dialog before discarding a continuation's edited suffix (Discard Continuation, Start New Run Instead).

hideGitIgnoredFiles.description: Hide files and directories ignored by .gitignore in the workspace file explorer and workflow file picker.

wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines in code views: the workspace file editor, script and condition editors, and diffs. When off, long lines extend past the view and scroll horizontally. The prompt editor always wraps.

atomicContextReferences.description: In the prompt editor, treat @file/#symbol/~git/$context references as single units: arrow keys skip over them and Backspace/Delete removes the whole reference at once. In output, format clickable local references as compact chips. Clicking or tapping a chip opens it, and right-clicking or long-pressing it offers Go to Reference, Copy Reference, and Send as Plain Text; when off, editor references edit character by character and output uses ordinary text links.

showCostEstimates.description: Show token cost estimates in dashboard and CLI statistics.

offerTrustForUntrustedFileLinks.description: Allow AI-generated file links outside trusted roots to offer a Trust Parent Folder action. Untrusted paths are always blocked unless their parent is explicitly trusted; this only controls whether the trust offer appears.

stepColorMode.description: Choose how workflow step identity colors are rendered: none uses status colors only, harness uses harness colors, and unique assigns a distinct color to each step.

harnessColors.description: Controls the per-harness identity colors used to correlate workflow steps across the dashboard.

byHarness.description: Optional hex color overrides for each harness. Remove an override to follow the built-in theme-aware chart color.

script.description: Hex color used for script steps.

autoStart.description: Automatically start the hosted dashboard server when the VS Code extension activates.

port.description: Port for the ctrlyoke hosted server.

fallbackPorts.description: Ordered ports to try, in order, if 'port' is already in use, before falling back to an OS-assigned port. Useful for a stable, bookmarkable URL across restarts when 'port' is often taken by another running instance.

theme.description: Color theme for the hosted server UI.

bindAddress.description: Network interface to bind the server to. Use '127.0.0.1' for localhost only or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

tls.description: TLS configuration for the hosted server.

certPath.description: Path to the TLS certificate file.

keyPath.description: Path to the TLS private key file.

iconBgColor.description: Background color for the workspace icon (hex, e.g. '#1076ba'). Applies to the SVG favicon and PWA homescreen icon.

iconFgColor.description: Foreground (path/stroke) color for the workspace icon (hex, e.g. '#ffffff'). Applies to the SVG favicon and PWA homescreen icon.

enabled.description: Show VS Code notification popups when workflows complete.

mode.description: When to send browser notifications. 'connectedOnly' fires while the hosted dashboard is open; 'push' enables background push notifications.

toastLevel.description: Minimum severity for operational toast/feedback popups, such as action results (save failures and validation errors); separate from completion notifications.

workflowComplete.description: When to notify on workflow completion.

promptComplete.description: When to notify on individual prompt completion.

hookEvents.description: Which hook events trigger notifications. All default to false (opt-in).

stop.description: Notify when the AI agent finishes responding.

sessionStart.description: Notify when a new AI session is created.

preToolUse.description: Notify before the AI invokes a tool.

postToolUse.description: Notify after the AI receives the result of a tool call.

userPromptSubmit.description: Notify when a user prompt is submitted to the AI.

permissionRequest.description: Notify when the AI requests permission to perform an action.

notification.description: Notify when the harness displays a notification, including prompts that may require user input.

error.description: Notify when the harness reports a session-level error.

includeWorkflowName.description: Include the workflow name in the notification message.

includePromptName.description: Include the prompt name in the notification message.

onlyWhenWindowUnfocused.description: Suppress notifications while the VS Code window or hosted dashboard is focused.

harness.description: Harness to use for commit message generation. Empty = use the workspace default harness.

model.description: Model override for commit message generation. Empty = use the commit harness default.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt sent before the git diff. The diff is appended automatically.
systemPrompt.default:
Generate a conventional commit message based on the included git diff. Return ONLY the final commit message content based on the included diff — no explanation, no code fences, no author or co-author attribution lines. Treat the provided diff and any optional user draft as the complete context for composing the message; do not read extra instruction files or inspect other workspace files unless explicitly instructed. Follow the Conventional Commits format: one or more 'type(scope): short description' header lines (use multiple headers if the change covers multiple distinct features or fixes), followed by a blank line, then one or more body paragraphs explaining the implementation details of what changed and why. Use markdown formatting in the body to improve readability where appropriate. Use bullet points for lists where necessary. If you are explicitly instructed to submit the message with a tool, call that tool with the complete commit message and do not repeat the message outside the tool call.

Example format:
feat(auth): add OAuth2 login support

Implemented OAuth2 authorization code flow using the existing HTTP client. Token refresh is handled automatically on 401 responses. Session state is persisted to localStorage to survive page reloads

Only return or submit the commit message, no extra text. Here is the git diff to generate the commit message for:

statusLine.description: Machine-only settings for providers that install a global statusline command.

useDifferentFormatPerHarness.description: Configure each harness's statusline format independently. When false (the default), every harness renders 'sharedFormat' and the per-harness 'format' values are left untouched but unused.

sharedFormat.description: Statusline format every harness renders while 'useDifferentFormatPerHarness' is false.

byHarness.description: Statusline configuration keyed by ctrlyoke harness ID.

verboseLogging.description: Enable verbose diagnostic logging for troubleshooting.

logRawCliOutput.description: Log raw CLI output to the extension output channel.

languageServerDefinition.description: Command, supported languages, and root markers for one managed language server.

command.description: Executable followed by its arguments. For example: ["pyright-langserver", "--stdio"].

languages.description: LSP language ids served by this definition.

extensions.description: File extensions served, without a leading dot.

rootMarkers.description: Files or directories used to find the project root.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the server process.

statusLineFormat.description: Ordered statusline segments. Used both for a provider's own 'format' and for the shared 'sharedFormat' that applies to every harness when 'useDifferentFormatPerHarness' is false.

enabled.description: Install ctrlyoke's statusline command for this harness.

customCommand.description: Command to run for the provider's statusline output.

useCtrlyokeStyle.description: Show ctrlyoke's branded statusline instead of custom-command output.

format.description: Statusline format for this harness, used only while 'useDifferentFormatPerHarness' is true.
